title: pm-dispatch protocol hardening: subagent claim identity, explicit draft bit, cross-lane same-file holds
body:
Fixes #12220
Fixes #12200
Fixes #12286

Family dispatch, chain head #12220 with members #12200 and #12286 — RESUMPTION of the W4 fold that died mid-edit on a model-tier quota limit. The rescue commit `a734b227` was inherited on the branch, `origin/main` was merged first (SKILL.md had moved after the rescue base), and the rescue was then reviewed hunk by hunk and corrected FORWARD with per-member commits. History was not rewritten; the rescue commit stays auditable.

Governed surface: this diff contains `.md` files under `.claude/**` — PR stays **draft**, human merge only.

## Per-member deliveries, each with a named checkable criterion

### #12220 — claim identity under `mode:subagent` (commit `b523e7cf9`)

The dispatch protocol said the claim comment's session ID distinguishes the dev's claim from the PM's; under `mode:subagent` (the default for S/M cards) the two IDs are identical by construction. All three dispositions, as promoted:

1. Claim rule 2 now names the **branch** as the distinguishing identity under `mode:subagent` and keeps the session ID as mandatory but mode-qualified.
2. The same sentence states what the claim-comment pair buys per mode — subagent: a dev ran, and on which branch; cloud: additionally which session.
3. The round-open mutex clause states the same-session reading as a deliberately kept safe direction (a subagent dev's claim reads as this session in flight and never triggers self-retreat — a same-session dev is not a mutex object; who it is, the branch answers), instead of safe-by-accident.

**Criterion**: claim rule 2 in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` names the branch as the claim's distinguishing identity and the per-mode purchases; the mutex clause carries the safe-direction sentence; `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` green at 1005/1005 with **zero** over-120-byte lines (the rescue state had 14).

### #12200 — `update_pull_request` always sends the draft bit (commit `bb49f525e`)

Rule stated over the WHOLE tool, per the promotion: any MCP call against a draft PR must pass `draft: true` explicitly — a reviewers-only review request published a governed-surface draft into a live merge queue in the sibling repo (2026-08-25).

- SKILL.md ACCEPT fork carries the requirement inline at the point of use, on metered lines; the endpoint-level detail lives in platform-readings. The already-enqueued remedy line prescribes draft-conversion AND disable, then verifying the queue ref.
- platform-readings: the `update_pull_request` fact row (rescue) is kept; the dedicated REST review-request path is **re-attributed as documented-not-measured** (this seat's repo-scoped REST probe answers 403, and no measurement record exists for the rescue's claimed date — the payload schema fact stands on the API docs).
- The measured contradiction is reconciled, both readings kept with boundaries: this repo measured draft-conversion dropping auto-merge and queue membership; the sibling repo measured an already-enqueued PR NOT dequeued by draft conversion (entry kept its position, merged about 40 minutes later) with `disable_pr_auto_merge` refusing at that point. Repo/timing difference undiagnosed; the surviving row prescribes the worst-case remedy (do both, verify queue ref and non-landing, never report remediated on a single reading) and states the two disable readings precisely (this repo: measured not to dequeue when called alone; sibling repo: the call refused outright).
- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` rule 2: the rationale against reverting another actor's ready flip no longer asserts only the direction the incident refuted — both measured directions carry it now.

**Criterion**: the ACCEPT fork's request-review passage requires explicit `draft: true` for MCP calls on a draft PR; the platform-readings row titled with draft-conversion reliability carries BOTH dated readings with repo boundaries and no picked side.

### #12286 — cross-lane same-file holds made legible (commits `a62f572d7`, `cb9ea5623`)

The two promoted halves only; the card's larger questions (cross-lane fence visibility in general, re-laning) stay on the card, not addressed here — #12286 scope beyond the two halves remains recorded on the card thread.

1. platform-readings: `mergeable_state` row now dated, states `unknown` is NOT a reading (measured: a dirty-headed PR answered unknown for the whole window and auto-merge was armed on it), and names the decisive zero-quota local probe — fetch the PR ref, `git merge-tree --write-tree` against current main.
2. `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` **H36**: report-only patrol row — open-PR pairs sharing a changed file where at least one side is accepted/armed. One changed-file page per open PR (bounded by the open population), H16's transport posture (partial reads are a stated gap; all-failed is the transport), a CLOSED two-spelling noise floor (pnpm lockfile, `.changeset/` prefix) pinned against per-incident growth, `changeset-release/*` excluded as candidates with the argument in the banner, and a read-X-of-Y coverage pair on the summary line. Patrol input, never a verdict — the row text says so.

**Criterion**: `node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test` green (1456 cases; 27 H36-labelled pins covering the firing shape, both silent directions, the noise floor, truncation, transport judgement, summary pair, and markdown rendering). Ablation below proves the pins can fail.

## Rescue reconciliation — kept, corrected, dropped

Kept on their merits: the reconciled draft-dequeue row shape, the `update_pull_request` row, the mergeable_state/merge-tree row, the mutex/claim/dispatch-order content, and the rescue's same-file byte-compressions in platform-readings (ledger below). Corrected: all 14 over-budget lines the rescue left in SKILL.md (its line count fit the ceiling only by illegal line widths — exactly the restructuring debt the dead dev's last note named); the request-review tool discipline moved OFF the quotation-exempt mega-line onto metered lines (the pre-existing mega-line rides the quotation exemption and was deliberately NOT extended); the disable-alone claim un-conflated into the two per-repo readings; the unverifiable measurement attribution downgraded to documented-not-measured. Dropped: the rescue's deletion of the conditional-request/304 fact (restored — it had no surviving home, and the lane charter reads a home-less cut as a lost rule).

## Cut ledger (platform-readings.md held at its 314-line ceiling; SKILL.md at 1005)

| cut (rescue or this PR) | surviving home |
|---|---|
| queue-ruleset row: "由 PR 上下文的 check run 满足" mechanism detail | core fact ("缺席不构成反证", 405 probe, rulesets API) survives in-row compressed |
| mergeable_state row: "重读一次拿真值" | superseded by the member-3 measurement (unknown can hold the whole window) — a refuted reading, removed rather than rehomed |
| mergeable_state row: "「draft+clean」组合不存在" | same fact survives as "draft PR 恒回 `draft`" |
| mergeable_state row: "该字段不老化" contrast | operative rule survives as "随 fetch 老化,重跑先 fetch" on the probe |
| undraft row standalone bullet | folded in substance into the `update_pull_request` row (all three path readings + dates kept) |
| enable_pr_auto_merge row: duplicated echo-reading narrative | consolidated in-row; both 2026-08-24 readings and the dead-hypothesis line survive |
| thin-params row: "3258-char first item" evidence detail + "tool-description reverse hint is false" | rule and its direct-observation evidence bar survive in-row |
| "文档载明、未实测: 304 不计 core 池" (rescue deleted) | **restored** onto the surviving quota line — no home existed |
| search-zeroing row: the two counter-evidence numbers and two candidate mechanisms | the refutation verdict and the raw-response requirement survive in-row |
| minutes-old-card row: specimen narrative | rule, boundary and date survive in-row |
| SKILL.md dispatch-order bullet: per-mode purchase restatement | single home is claim rule 2, pointed to |

## Verification (tree `cb9ea5623` = this PR's head, union run at that head under the shared verify lock)

- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` — green: SKILL.md 1005/1005 (widest table row 765/765 untouched), platform-readings 314/314 (table-row pin 0 untouched), os-dev.md 470/470, zero over-budget lines anywhere.
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` — green, 22 files clean.
- `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync` and `check:skill-frame-freshness` — green (4 copies isomorphic; current with origin/main).
- `node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test` — green, 1456 cases.
- **Ablation** (from committed state, trap-restored): mutated `h36SharedFileHolds` to drop every pair; mutation proven on disk by anchored grep counts (orig 1 to 0, mutant 0 to 1); self-test then FAILED exit 1 with exactly the 10 H36 firing pins red and the suite running to completion (the null-guard wrappers held); restore verified by empty `git diff HEAD` plus worktree blob hash equal to HEAD blob hash. No build step exists on this path (the script runs from source), so no dist leg applies.
- Full derived union (26 families from `dispatch-gates.mjs`, no paths passed — derivation stderr named this repo at commit `cb9ea562`): all green, including the two convention-triggered obligations for editing a gate script (`bare-root-worklist --self-test`, `check:pm-dispatch-gates`), `check:nul-bytes`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:pm-governed-prose`, `check:pm-half-states`, governed-queue-guard self-test, and `check:doc-formula-expressions` (green after building `@objectstack/lint`; the first run was its PREREQUISITE NOT MET refusal, not a measurement). `check:partof-closing-keyword` was run locally against THIS body via `PR_BODY` before opening the PR.
- Changeset: none — `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` only, nothing releases; `skip-changeset` label applied and read back.
